Priya (Finance): @channel Quick heads-up: we're replacing the current 'floating free slab' credit behavior with a fixed monthly allocation per account to reduce surprising prorates and simplify quota math. Cutover date: 2026-06-15 UTC.

Priya (Finance): Summary: total annual free credit stays the same; we will divide it evenly across 12 months. Customers with material intra-month variance get a 14-day rollback window plus an automatic 30% transient credit cushion for the first two post-cutover billing cycles if flagged as 'burst-risk'.

Marco (Billing): Dev note: conversion formula = round(annual_total / 12), residual cents added to the first month. We'll emit an invoice.credit_migration.v1 event at cutover for observability and downstream reconcile.

Marco (Billing): Data request: run a preview job that flags accounts where new monthly allocation differs from median monthly usage by >40%. CSV to billing + support by 2026-05-20. Include columns: account_id, annual_total, new_monthly_alloc, median_monthly_usage, rollback_eligible (bool), burst_risk_score, migration_id.

Tess (Product): Comms plan: 1) email + console banner 2 weeks prior; 2) in-console preview tool showing per-account simulated monthly credit and estimated invoice impact; 3) opt-in early migration for beta customers. Draft console copy below.

Aisha (Support): Support playbook: - If customer reports >15% cost delta, escalate to #billing-escalations and billing@. - Use migration-preview tool to pull migration_id and cushion eligibility. - If within 14-day rollback window, open rollback request and tag legal for approval.

Darren (Legal): Rollback rules: one rollback per account for this migration, requires a signed digital form (automated). Rollback may require sales approval if the account has Dedicated reservations. Legal will provide short consent copy for emails.

Priya (Finance): Cushion details: the 30% transient-credit cushion is applied as invoice credit (not cash) and auto-applies for two cycles for accounts marked burst-risk. Not retroactive.

ops-billing-bot: queued_email:5871 created -> preview_emails scheduled 2026-06-01T08:00:00Z

Tess (Product): Console preview copy: 

``
Starting 15 June 2026 we will convert annual free credits into a fixed monthly allocation. Your total annual credits remain unchanged; you can preview the converted monthly amount and estimated invoice impact in the simulator. If you expect a material change, you may opt into early migration or request rollback within 14 days after your account cutover.

[Preview converted monthly credit] (opens simulation)
``

Aisha (Support): Quick Q: Marco, will the preview CSV include rollback_eligible header so we can show it in Zendesk?

Marco (Billing): Yes — CSV includes rollback_eligible and burst_risk_score. Also adds migration_id for tracking.

Darren (Legal): Please include this one-line in the email footer: "We may modify free credit allocations; rollback requests are subject to review and may affect committed reservations." Final legal copy tomorrow.

Priya (Finance): Timeline recap: - 2026-05-20: preview CSV to internal teams - 2026-06-01: console banner + queued preview emails - 2026-06-15: cutover, event emitted, cushion applied - 14-day rollback window opens per account at cutover.

Tess (Product): Engineering checklist: - migration preview API (read-only) - console widget for simulation - emit invoice.credit_migration.v1 at cutover - implement transient-credit cushion in invoice pipeline - expose migration_id on invoices and support tools.

Priya (Finance): Safety valve: if >0.5% of active accounts request rollback within 48 hours of cutover, pause rollout for 24 hours and run an RCA.

Aisha (Support): I'll run a 90-min training for agents on 2026-06-03 and share sample responses.

Marco (Billing): Sample support reply: 

"Hi <customer>, we converted your annual free credits to a fixed monthly allocation on 15 June. Your account shows a [+/\- X%] change vs prior month. If you'd like, we can open a rollback request (available for 14 days). Please share your typical monthly usage for the last 3 months to speed review. — Marco, Billing"

Darren (Legal): Note to Sales: cc legal on renewals where the migration changes pricing for committed reservations.

Priya (Finance): Action items: Marco: preview CSV by 2026-05-20; Eng: preview API + console widget by 2026-06-01; Support: training and rollback intake by 2026-06-03; Legal: final email/legal line by 2026-05-22.

Tess (Product): :eyes: will link preview tool PR here when ready.

Aisha (Support): :thumbsup: thanks all, will prep deck and sample tickets.

Priya (Finance): Thanks team. Ping me if you want a demo account; I can allocate migration_id for testing.
